import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 150;
    static int[][] pos = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] matTempo = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] matAlc = new int[MAX][MAX];

    static class FlowEdge {
        int v, u;
        long cap, flow = 0;
        FlowEdge(int v, int u, long cap) {
            this.v = v;
            this.u = u;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        final long flowInf = (long) 1e18;
        ArrayList<FlowEdge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Integer>[] adj;
        int n, m = 0;
        int s, t;
        int[] level, ptr;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();

        Dinic(int n, int s, int t) {
            this.n = n;
            this.s = s;
            this.t = t;
            adj = new ArrayList[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void add(int v, int u, long cap) {
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(v, u, cap));
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(u, v, 0));
            adj[v].add(m);
            adj[u].add(m + 1);
            m += 2;
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int idx : adj[v]) {
                    FlowEdge e = edges.get(idx);
                    if (e.cap - e.flow < 1) continue;
                    if (level[e.u] != -1) continue;
                    level[e.u] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.add(e.u);
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int v, long pushed) {
            if (pushed == 0) return 0;
            if (v == t) return pushed;
            for (int i = ptr[v]; i < adj[v].size(); i++) {
                ptr[v] = i;
                int idx = adj[v].get(i);
                FlowEdge e = edges.get(idx);
                int u = e.u;
                if (level[v] + 1 != level[u] || e.cap - e.flow < 1) continue;
                long tr = dfs(u, Math.min(pushed, e.cap - e.flow));
                if (tr == 0) continue;
                e.flow += tr;
                edges.get(idx ^ 1).flow -= tr;
                return tr;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long flow() {
            long f = 0;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(level, -1);
                level[s] = 0;
                q.add(s);
                if (!bfs()) break;
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = dfs(s, flowInf)) > 0)
                    f += pushed;
            }
            return f;
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int a, int b) { first = a; second = b; }
    }

    static ArrayList<Pair> getNeighbors(int i, int j, int n) {
        ArrayList<Pair> viz = new ArrayList<>();
        if (i + 1 < n) viz.add(new Pair(i+1, j));
        if (i - 1 >= 0) viz.add(new Pair(i-1, j));
        if (j + 1 < n) viz.add(new Pair(i, j+1));
        if (j - 1 >= 0) viz.add(new Pair(i, j-1));
        return viz;
    }

    static void createMatTempo(int i, int j, String[] sc, int n, int currT) {
        if (i >= n || i < 0 || j >= n || j < 0) return;
        char c = sc[i].charAt(j);
        if (!(Character.isDigit(c) || c == 'Z')) return;
        if (matTempo[i][j] != -1 && matTempo[i][j] <= currT) return;
        if (matTempo[i][j] == -1)
            matTempo[i][j] = currT;
        else
            matTempo[i][j] = Math.min(currT, matTempo[i][j]);
        createMatTempo(i+1, j, sc, n, currT+1);
        createMatTempo(i-1, j, sc, n, currT+1);
        createMatTempo(i, j+1, sc, n, currT+1);
        createMatTempo(i, j-1, sc, n, currT+1);
    }

    static void createMatAlc(int i, int j, String[] sc, int n, int currT) {
        if (i >= n || i < 0 || j >= n || j < 0) return;
        char c = sc[i].charAt(j);
        if (!Character.isDigit(c)) return;
        if (matAlc[i][j] != -1 && matAlc[i][j] <= currT) return;
        if (matAlc[i][j] == -1)
            matAlc[i][j] = currT;
        else
            matAlc[i][j] = Math.min(currT, matAlc[i][j]);
        createMatAlc(i+1, j, sc, n, currT+1);
        createMatAlc(i-1, j, sc, n, currT+1);
        createMatAlc(i, j+1, sc, n, currT+1);
        createMatAlc(i, j-1, sc, n, currT+1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Thread(null, new Runnable() {
            public void run() {
                solve();
            }
        }, "solution", 1 << 25).start();
    }

    static void solve() {
        Scanner scObj = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scObj.nextInt();
        int t = scObj.nextInt();
        int n2 = n * n;
        int nMax = n2 * 2;
        Dinic grafo = new Dinic(nMax + 2, 0, nMax + 1);
        String[] sc = new String[n];
        String[] caps = new String[n];
        int iZ = 0, jZ = 0;

        // assign positions
        int cnt = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(pos[i], 0);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                pos[i][j] = cnt;
                cnt++;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sc[i] = scObj.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (sc[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    iZ = i;
                    jZ = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) caps[i] = scObj.next();

        // initialize matTempo with -1
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX; i++) Arrays.fill(matTempo[i], -1);
        createMatTempo(iZ, jZ, sc, n, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (matTempo[i][j] == -1 && Character.isDigit(sc[i].charAt(j)))
                    matTempo[i][j] = t;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(sc[i].charAt(j))) {
                    int lmt = sc[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                    grafo.add(0, pos[i][j], lmt);
                    // reset matAlc
                    for (int x = 0; x < MAX; x++) Arrays.fill(matAlc[x], -1);
                    createMatAlc(i, j, sc, n, 0);
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                            if (matAlc[k][l] != -1 && matTempo[k][l] != -1 &&
                                matAlc[k][l] <= matTempo[k][l] && matAlc[k][l] <= t) {
                                boolean crt = true;
                                if (matAlc[k][l] == matTempo[k][l]) {
                                    crt = false;
                                    if (k+1 < n && matAlc[k+1][l] != -1 && matAlc[k+1][l] < matTempo[k+1][l]) crt = true;
                                    if (k-1 >= 0 && matAlc[k-1][l] != -1 && matAlc[k-1][l] < matTempo[k-1][l]) crt = true;
                                    if (l+1 < n && matAlc[k][l+1] != -1 && matAlc[k][l+1] < matTempo[k][l+1]) crt = true;
                                    if (l-1 >= 0 && matAlc[k][l-1] != -1 && matAlc[k][l-1] < matTempo[k][l-1]) crt = true;
                                }
                                if (crt) {
                                    grafo.add(pos[i][j], n2 + pos[k][l], lmt);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(caps[i].charAt(j))) {
                    grafo.add(n2 + pos[i][j], nMax+1, caps[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = grafo.flow();
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
